note.km: បកប្រែពីភាសាអ៊ីតាលី

text.en: Great purchase! I was here this morning, but since it was the first store I visited, I didn't buy right away. I went back at the end of the day because they had the most beautiful silver in town. Great prices, and the lady was very kind and smiling. While I waited, she even polished the bracelet I had chosen! Thank you by Italian Girl!

note.km: បកប្រែពីភាសាបារាំង

text.en: The best shop for money, jewelry, and other items. Quality at affordable prices. Credit cards accepted! We've been going there for over 20 years. Highly recommended.
Beautiful array of silver jewellery. Reasonable pricess
